Draft 1 of 5 · bugs/gs-unused-value-crash.md

High Module: CRM Related: NDC-2870 Sprint 16 (if filed)

Global Sets | Deleting an unused value, or opening "Where is this value used" on it, crashes the Settings page


Summary In the Edit Global Set dialog, the Unused Values section shows two icons on each unused value: "Where is this value used" and Delete. Clicking either one replaces the whole Settings page with "Something went wrong". So an unused value can't be deleted from the screen, and any unsaved edits in the dialog are lost. Deleting the same value through the API works. Found while retesting NDC-2870 (gap item 2, "Delete an unused value for good").
Steps to Reproduce
  • Go to CRM > Setup > Modules and Fields > Global Sets.
  • Open a set that has at least one unused value (e.g. "QA RT19 GS Tier", unused value "Copper"; any value removed from the list goes to Unused).
  • In Edit Global Set, scroll to Unused Values.
  • Click the "Where is this value used" icon next to the unused value.
  • Reload, open the set again, and click the Delete (bin) icon next to the same unused value.

    • Expected Result
  • Step 4: a panel lists where the value is still used, or says it is not used.
  • Step 5: a confirmation, then the value is deleted for good. A value still in use is refused with a clear message.
  • The page keeps working in both cases.

    • Actual Result
  • Steps 4 and 5: the page shows "Something went wrong · An unexpected error occurred. Try refreshing the page or contact support if the problem persists." (Try again / Copy error details). The browser console shows a TypeError reading 'length'.
  • The value is not deleted, and edits not yet saved in the dialog are lost.
  • Control: the API works. POST …/global-sets/{id}/values/delete returns 200 for an unused value (deleted), 422 NOT_UNUSED for a used value, 409 IN_USE for an unused value still on a record, and 422 for two values at once.

    • Environment staging-crm.taviportal.com (NDC-Staging), ndc-staging-owner, Edge, 16 Nov 2026.
    Suggested priority: High (crashes the Setup page; the only screen path to delete a value is broken)
    Related: NDC-2870 (Global Sets gap list, item 2)
    Evidence: BUG-gs-unused-value-crash-FAIL.png, BUG-gs-unused-value-crash-vs-zoho.png
    Zoho CRM comparison Zoho deletes values only from Edit Global Set > gear > View / Add Unused Values, one value at a time. A value still in use is refused ("Option delete not allowed"), and two at once are refused ("More than one picklist value cannot be deleted"). The page keeps working. Seen live in a Zoho CRM test org on 11 Nov 2026.

    Draft 2 of 5 · bugs/gs-sort-order-ignored.md

    Medium Module: CRM Related: NDC-2870 Sprint 16 (if filed)

    Global Sets | List views and reports ignore the set's saved "Entered order" and sort A–Z


    Summary A global set can now be saved with Sort order = Entered order or Alphabetical. The editor says "Pick lists, list views, filters, reports and dashboards that use this set show its values in this order." The pick list options follow it, but a list view or report sorted by the field still sorts A–Z in both modes. Found while retesting NDC-2870 (gap item 3).
    Steps to Reproduce
  • Go to CRM > Setup > Modules and Fields > Global Sets and open a set linked to a Leads field (e.g. "QA RT19 GS Tier").
  • Make the values Silver, Platinum, Bronze in that order, choose Sort order = Entered order, and Save.
  • Give 3 leads the values Silver, Platinum and Bronze.
  • Open Leads, pick a list view showing them, and sort by the field, ascending.
  • Create a Leads report sorted by the field.
  • Switch the set to Alphabetical, save, and repeat steps 4–5.

    • Expected Result
  • With Entered order, list views and reports sorted by the field show Silver, Platinum, Bronze.
  • With Alphabetical, they show Bronze, Platinum, Silver.

    • Actual Result
  • The setting is saved and the pick list options follow it.
  • The list view sorted ascending by the field shows Bronze, Platinum, Silver (A–Z) in both modes. The report is the same.

    • Environment staging-crm.taviportal.com (NDC-Staging), ndc-staging-owner, Edge + API, 16 Nov 2026.
    Suggested priority: Medium (the setting has no effect where the editor says it applies)
    Related: NDC-2870 (Global Sets gap list, item 3)
    Evidence: BUG-gs-sort-order-ignored-FAIL.png, BUG-gs-sort-order-ignored-vs-zoho.png
    Zoho CRM comparison Zoho's Sort order preference (Entered / Alphabetical) says "The order customized here will be followed in List views, reports and dashboards where sorting is applied for the picklist field." Live check on 16 Nov 2026 in a Zoho CRM test org: a set with the same entered order, and a Leads view sorted ascending by the field, shows Silver, Platinum, Bronze.

    Draft 3 of 5 · bugs/gs-used-in-no-reports.md

    Medium Module: CRM Related: NDC-2870 Sprint 16 (if filed)

    Global Sets | Used In does not list the reports that use the set's field


    Summary The Used In panel of a global set lists custom views, workflow rules, blueprints and dependency maps that use the set's fields, but never the reports, even when a report filters or sorts on the field. An admin who checks Used In before changing or deleting values cannot see that reports depend on them. The system knows about the reports: the report field-usage API returns them. Found while retesting NDC-2870 (gap item 7; PRD requirement S6 "Used In shows reports").
    Steps to Reproduce
  • Go to CRM > Setup > Modules and Fields > Global Sets and open a set linked to a Leads pick list field (e.g. "QA RT19 GS Tier").
  • Go to Reports and create a Leads report with a filter on that field (e.g. "QA RT19 GS Gold report", Tier = Gold). Create a second report sorted by the field ("QA RT19 GS Sort report").
  • Go back to Global Sets and click the set's Used In link.

    • Expected Result
  • Used In lists the 2 reports together with the views, rules, blueprints and dependency maps (PRD S6).

    • Actual Result
  • Used In shows Leads > QA RT19 GS Tier with Custom views, Workflow rules, Blueprints and Dependency maps only. No Reports line.
  • GET /reporting/field-usage does return both reports, but the body is wrapped twice (data.data.reports).
  • Control: Replace (Gold → Silver) did update the report filter, so reports are covered by Replace but not shown in Used In.

    • Environment staging-crm.taviportal.com (NDC-Staging), ndc-staging-owner, Edge + API, 16 Nov 2026.
    Suggested priority: Medium (admins can't see report dependencies before changing values)
    Related: NDC-2870 (Global Sets gap list, item 7); PRD S6
    Evidence: BUG-gs-used-in-no-reports-FAIL.png
    Zoho CRM comparison Not a Zoho-parity item. Zoho's Used In ("Associated places") lists modules, fields and layouts only, not reports. This draft is against TAVI's own PRD (S6) and TAVI's own Used In panel, which already goes beyond Zoho by listing views, rules, blueprints and dependency maps. No vs-Zoho image.

    Draft 5 of 5 · bugs/agent-reassign-strips-all.md

    Low (API only) Module: Desk Related: NDC-2850 Sprint 16 (if filed)

    Agents API | Reassign removes the agent from every department, team and round-robin pool, not only the departments in the request


    Summary The reassign endpoint is the one behind the Remove from Desk dialog. It takes a list of departments, each with a new owner (or "unassigned"). When it is called with only some of the agent's departments, it still removes the agent from every department, team and round-robin pool in the org, including the ones not in the request. The screen always sends every department, so screen users don't hit this. Any API client that sends a partial list (e.g. to hand over just one department) silently strips the agent everywhere. API only. Found while retesting NDC-2850 (item 6).
    Steps to Reproduce
  • As an admin, pick an agent who belongs to several departments and teams and is in round-robin pools (e.g. Dev Team 2: 36 departments, 14 teams). Note their memberships.
  • Call POST /api/v1/desk/agents/{agent id}/reassign with only 2 of those departments: department A → another agent, department B → unassigned, update_rules true.
  • Read the agent's departments, teams, round-robin pools and references again.

    • Expected Result
  • Only departments A and B are handed over as requested (rules, pools, SLA escalations there pass to the chosen agent or are left unassigned).
  • The agent's other department memberships, teams and pools stay as they were, or the call is refused if a partial list isn't allowed.

    • Actual Result
  • 200 success. The response counts department_memberships 37, round_robin_pools 18, team_sources 14, sla_escalations 2.
  • Afterwards the agent has 0 memberships, 0 pools, 0 teams, and left 33 departments that were not in the request (e.g. QA AO Dept A, QA NDC Accounting, QA NDC KSA Branch).
  • Departments A and B were handled as asked (SLA levels → the chosen agent / left empty).
  • Everything had to be restored by hand (35 memberships, main department, 14 teams, 18 pools), and some pool restores were refused because the agent was no longer a member.

    • Environment staging-desk.taviportal.com (NDC-Staging), API as ndc-staging-owner, 16 Nov 2026 15:25Z. All memberships were restored and verified against the snapshot.
    Suggested priority: Low (API only; the screen sends all departments). Raise it if integrations or scripts call this endpoint.
    Related: NDC-2850 (Remove agent / SLA escalation handover)
    Evidence: BUG-agent-reassign-strips-all-FAIL.png
    Zoho Desk comparison Not compared. In Zoho, removing an agent from one department is a separate action from deactivating or deleting the agent, so there is no direct equivalent of a "partial reassign" call.

    BUG-agent-reassign-strips-all-FAIL.png
